regressions.execution: All 31 suites passed in one full regression run.

coveredBehavior: Real TCP HELP requests are owner-gated and do not resolve or create a conversation
BOT_OPEN, FAQ answers and explicit human handoff traverse the actual relay command dispatcher
CLIENT and BOT replies save atomically; save failures roll back both and duplicate retries replay the original pair
FAQ admin-only API validates input and revision, supports hide/delete and rolls back failed persistence
Published FAQ edits update public help and subsequent bot replies; persisted FAQ, bot role, mode and reply linkage survive import
Support ownership, offline human handoff, admin replies, close/reopen and delete revision/epoch behavior
Profile post counts and 12-item grid pages exclude other owners, hidden and deleted posts; previews are bounded while detail retains body
Web DOM renders BOT bubbles, saves actual FAQ forms, escapes text and preserves conversation and FAQ drafts
Existing QR, wallet, purchase, authorization, lifecycle, profile synchronization, support persistence and web suites
nativeSourceGuards: Unique support fields and matching method signatures; six split includes resolve
Profile statistics, three-column text grid and QR charge inside balance; standalone shortcuts removed from profile only
Bracketed list/detail titles with body omitted from news and catalog lists
Four styled ComboBox options and visible popup/input containers; polling protects an open picker
Header SVG compose action, metadata under author and single feed timeline
Centered menu search prompt and no category filter buttons
Uniform white/black page/surface theme and corresponding system bars
FAQ-first full screen support, fixed composer with OnChangeTracking and BOT/HUMAN roles
Message rendering waits for scroll/touch, paged display preserves stored history, cursor/epoch and pending request logic retained
Support data and timers cleared on service stop/destruction; hardware back resolves support before dashboard
FIX18 and FIX19 touch, automatic/pull refresh, reaction and profile synchronization source guards
